articles.title: Daylight Jewellery Heist in Karnataka: Armed Robbers Fire Shots, Flee with Gold & Silver Worth Lakhs
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two armed and masked robbers carried out a daring daylight robbery at a jewellery store in Halsangi village of Chadachan taluk, Vijayapura district, on Monday afternoon, looting gold and silver worth several lakhs of rupees.

body.html:
Two armed and masked robbers carried out a daring daylight robbery at a jewellery store in Halsangi village of Chadachan taluk, Vijayapura district, on Monday afternoon, looting gold and silver worth several lakhs of rupees.

According to police, the accused stormed into Maharudra Kanchagar’s jewellery shop around 4 pm, pointed a pistol at the owner and staff, and fired two shots in the air to create panic. They escaped with 305 grams of gold and 1.5 kg of silver.

During the incident, a bystander, Atmalinga Hugar, was injured when a bullet fired by the robbers hit him. Another local, Anil, was reportedly targeted when he tried to record the incident, but the shot struck someone else standing nearby.

CCTV footage shows the two men wearing helmets, monkey caps, black jackets, gloves, and arriving on a black Honda Unicorn motorcycle, which they used to flee the scene. One robber is seen looting jewellery while the other holds staff at gunpoint. A woman outside the shop was also threatened.

Police have registered a case and launched an investigation based on CCTV footage. Officials suspect the accused may have fled towards Maharashtra.

A distraught shop owner, Maharudra, told the media that the stolen jewellery was his family’s livelihood and that they were already struggling with debts.

The incident has shaken the local community and raised concerns over rising daylight crimes in the region.

articles.title: Chain Snatching Inside AIIMS Bhopal Lift Raises Serious Security Concerns
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An incident of chain snatching has been reported inside the AIIMS Bhopal campus, where a woman employee was targeted inside a lift.

body.html:
An incident of chain snatching has been reported inside the AIIMS Bhopal campus, where a woman employee was targeted inside a lift. The incident occurred on Sunday but came to light on Monday after CCTV footage surfaced, raising questions over security arrangements at the premier hospital.

The incident took place in a lift located behind the blood bank. The victim, identified as Varsha, was alone in the lift while on duty when a masked young man entered. Pretending to seek information, he asked her about a medical department.

As the lift reached the third floor, the man stepped out, suddenly turned back and attempted to snatch her mangalsutra. When the woman resisted, the accused pushed her aside and fled towards the staircase, escaping with the chain.

At the time of the incident, no security guard was posted near the lift. The matter came to light later when a guard arrived during routine rounds and alerted senior officials. The victim then approached Bagsewania police station and lodged a complaint.

Due to the Sunday holiday and Republic Day on January 26, patient movement on the campus was relatively low. Preliminary investigation suggests that the accused escaped through the IPD gate. He has not yet been identified.

While theft incidents have been reported earlier on the AIIMS Bhopal campus, officials said this is the first reported case of chain snatching, triggering concerns over the hospital administration’s security measures. Police have begun an investigation based on CCTV footage.

#AIIMSBhopal #BhopalCrime #ChainSnatching #HospitalSecurity #CCTVFootage #WomenSafety #MPPolice #SecurityLapse

articles.title: Bride Gives Birth on Wedding Night in UP Village, Love Affair Behind Shocking Turn of Events
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A startling incident from Rampur district in Uttar Pradesh has left an entire village stunned after a newlywed bride gave birth to a baby girl just hours after her marriage. The incident took place in Kumhariya village under the Azimnagar police station area.

body.html:
A startling incident from Rampur district in Uttar Pradesh has left an entire village stunned after a newlywed bride gave birth to a baby girl just hours after her marriage. The incident took place in Kumhariya village under the Azimnagar police station area.

According to information, Rizwan, a resident of Kumhariya village, married a young woman from Bahadurganj after police intervention and mediation by village elders. Police sources said the couple had been in a love relationship for some time, following which the woman approached the Azimnagar police station and the Mursaina outpost demanding marriage. With the consent of both families, the marriage was solemnised.

On Saturday evening, Rizwan brought the bride to his home after the wedding rituals. However, around midnight, the bride complained of severe abdominal pain, creating panic in the household. A local female doctor was immediately called, who provided first aid. By Sunday morning, the bride delivered a baby girl at home.

As the news spread, villagers gathered at the house, and women from the locality arrived to bless the newborn, offering traditional sweets and expressing happiness over the child’s birth.

Azimnagar police station in-charge Karan Singh said preliminary investigation revealed that the couple had a prior relationship and the woman was already pregnant before the marriage. Police stated that no legal action was required at present, as the marriage had taken place with mutual consent and family agreement.

The incident has since become a major topic of discussion in the village.

articles.title: Excise Constable Run Over While Stopping Ganja Smugglers in Telangana, Loses Kidney
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 23-year-old excise constable was critically injured after being run over by suspected ganja smugglers during a routine vehicle check in Telangana’s Nizamabad district. The incident occurred on January 23, 2026, near Madhavnagar village.

body.html:
A 23-year-old excise constable was critically injured after being run over by suspected ganja smugglers during a routine vehicle check in Telangana’s Nizamabad district. The incident occurred on January 23, 2026, near Madhavnagar village.

The injured officer, Gajula Soumya, had been serving in the excise department for the past 20 months. According to officials, an excise team stopped a car on suspicion of ganja transport. During the check, the driver suddenly reversed the vehicle, knocking down Soumya, before crashing into a tree or an electric pole and fleeing the spot.

Soumya sustained severe abdominal injuries and was rushed to a private hospital in Nizamabad, where she was admitted to the ICU. Doctors were forced to surgically remove one of her kidneys due to the extent of the injuries. While her condition was initially critical, some reports later stated that she was out of immediate danger.

Excise officials registered a case against five suspected ganja smugglers from Nirmal district at the Nizamabad police station. Two of the accused were arrested shortly after the incident, and around 2 kg of dry ganja was seized from the vehicle. Efforts are underway to trace and arrest the remaining suspects.

Following the incident, agitated excise staff staged a dharna demanding strict action against those responsible and raising concerns over alleged lapses by a circle inspector. Senior officials, including Deputy Commissioner V. Somireddy, assured the staff of justice and announced that Soumya would receive her full salary until recovery. An internal inquiry has also been initiated.

The incident has once again highlighted the serious risks faced by enforcement personnel involved in curbing ganja smuggling in the region.

articles.title: SHO Jumps Into Drain to Save Child: Meerut Search Operation Exposes Deadly Open Drains
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a dramatic rescue attempt in Meerut’s TP Nagar area, Station House Officer (SHO) Arun Mishra jumped into a deep, fast-flowing open drain to search for a child reportedly swept away while collecting glass bottles.

body.html:
In a dramatic rescue attempt in Meerut’s TP Nagar area, Station House Officer (SHO) Arun Mishra jumped into a deep, fast-flowing open drain to search for a child reportedly swept away while collecting glass bottles. The incident took place near Delhi Road Mandi and triggered a large-scale rescue operation involving police, fire services and municipal teams.

According to initial information, a 10-year-old boy was suspected to have fallen into the drain. However, despite hours of intensive search, authorities have not been able to confirm the child’s fall or trace him so far.

SHO Arun Mishra removed his police uniform and personally entered the drain, searching for several hours. JCB machines were deployed to clear debris and sludge from the drain across a stretch of nearly one kilometre to aid the operation.

Police said rescue teams also checked nearby areas and questioned local residents, but no concrete evidence confirming the child’s presence in the drain has emerged. As of January 26–27, 2026, the search operation was still ongoing without any breakthrough.

The incident has once again highlighted serious civic lapses in Meerut, particularly the danger posed by open drains. Officials said this is the third such incident reported in the city within the last 10 days. Municipal authorities have cited maintenance-related issues, while locals have blamed negligence and lack of safety measures.

articles.title: Loyal Till the End: Pet Dog Guards Bodies of Two Cousins for 3 Days in Snowbound Himachal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a tragic incident from Himachal Pradesh’s Chamba district, the bodies of two cousins, Piyush Kumar (13) and Vikas Rana, who went missing while shooting a reel, were recovered after three days, with their pet dog found guarding them amid heavy snowfall.

body.html:
In a tragic incident from Himachal Pradesh’s Chamba district, the bodies of two cousins, Piyush Kumar (13) and Vikas Rana, who went missing while shooting a reel, were recovered after three days, with their pet dog found guarding them amid heavy snowfall.

The duo had left home on January 23 to hike towards the Bharmani Mata Temple in Bharmour to record videos but failed to return. Following an extensive search operation involving drones and Army helicopters, rescue teams located the bodies on Monday.

When the teams reached the spot, they found the family’s pet pitbull dog sitting beside the bodies, guarding them in sub-zero temperatures. Despite snowstorms, freezing winds and lack of food or water, the dog reportedly stayed with its owners for nearly three days and nights.

Rescue personnel said the dog showed no aggression and remained close to the bodies even as they approached. Considering the emotional bond, the rescue team airlifted both the body of Piyush and the dog together to Bharmour.

Local MLA Dr Janak Raj confirmed that the dog was safely rescued and handed over to the grieving family. The incident has deeply moved locals, with many calling it a rare and powerful example of loyalty in the face of tragedy.

articles.title: Crop Damage Row Turns Brutal: Woman Farmer Tied to Pole, Assault Video Shocks Karnataka
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident from Karnataka has come to light after a woman farmer was allegedly tied to a pole and assaulted by members of a neighbouring family in Chamarajanagar district.

body.html:
A disturbing incident from Karnataka has come to light after a woman farmer was allegedly tied to a pole and assaulted by members of a neighbouring family in Chamarajanagar district. The incident occurred in GR Nagar village of Hanur taluk and surfaced after a video of the assault went viral on social media.

The victim has been identified as Kannamma, who had cultivated horse gram on her agricultural land. According to police sources, cattle belonging to a neighbouring woman, Selvi, strayed into Kannamma’s field and damaged the crop, triggering a fresh dispute between the two families. Police said the families had previous disagreements, which further escalated the situation.

During the confrontation, Selvi, along with Manju and Angamuthu, allegedly tied Kannamma to a pole and assaulted her. The incident was recorded on a mobile phone and later circulated widely, drawing public outrage.

After receiving information, Ramapura police rushed to the spot and took Selvi, Manju and Angamuthu into custody. An FIR has been registered, and a detailed investigation is underway.

Chamarajanagar Superintendent of Police Muthuraj visited GR Nagar village, inspected the spot and reviewed the case. Police said further legal action will be taken based on the investigation and statements recorded.

articles.title: Cigarette Lighter Fight Turns Fatal: Bengaluru ‘Accident’ Now Probed as Cold-Blooded Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: What was initially reported as a tragic road accident on the outskirts of Bengaluru has now been reclassified as murder, following a detailed police investigation and a complaint filed by the victim’s mother.

body.html:
What was initially reported as a tragic road accident on the outskirts of Bengaluru has now been reclassified as murder, following a detailed police investigation and a complaint filed by the victim’s mother.

The incident occurred on Sunday evening around 8.30 pm in the Kammasandra area, under the Hebbagodi police station limits of Anekal taluk. The deceased has been identified as Prashanth (28), a resident of Veerasandra. The accused is Roshan Hegde (27), a resident of KR Puram.

According to police, Prashanth and Roshan had gathered near M5 Mall after attending a local cricket match and were consuming alcohol when an argument broke out. Investigators said the dispute allegedly began over a cigarette lighter and escalated into a violent confrontation, during which both men reportedly attacked each other with beer bottles. Roshan sustained serious injuries, including a severe injury to his tongue.

As tensions rose, Roshan attempted to leave the spot in his car. Prashanth tried to stop him and held on to the vehicle’s door, hanging outside as the car moved. Instead of stopping, Roshan allegedly drove recklessly along the Veerasandra–Kammasandra road.

Electronic City Division DCP Narayan said dashboard camera footage revealed that the accused deliberately rammed the car into a tree and later into a compound wall in an apparent attempt to dislodge Prashanth. The impact caused fatal head injuries to Prashanth.

Although the emergency helpline 112 was initially informed of a crash, police said analysis of the dashcam footage and steering patterns indicated clear intent, leading them to alter the case from rash and negligent driving to murder. The accused was taken into custody within an hour of the incident and is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital.

Prashanth’s mother, Anu, alleged that her son was intentionally killed and not a victim of an accident. She said the family had recently built a new house and was planning his wedding in two months. “If he made a mistake, he could have been warned. He did not deserve to be killed,” she said, demanding strict action.

Based on her complaint, Hebbagodi police have registered a murder case under Section 302 of the IPC. Prashanth’s body has been shifted to St John’s Hospital for post-mortem examination. Police said further investigation is underway to establish the full sequence of events and motive behind the crime.

articles.title: ‘Marry Me or Go to Jail’: DUDA Woman’s Harassment Case Takes Political Turn in Mau
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young woman working with the District Urban Development Agency (DUDA) in Mau, Uttar Pradesh, has accused her colleague of sexually harassing her on the pretext of marriage. Police have registered an FIR and arrested the accused, Ankit Singh, who has been sent to jail.

body.html:
A young woman working with the District Urban Development Agency (DUDA) in Mau, Uttar Pradesh, has accused her colleague of sexually harassing her on the pretext of marriage. Police have registered an FIR and arrested the accused, Ankit Singh, who has been sent to jail. Further investigation is underway.

The accused was earlier described as an engineer, but officials have clarified that Ankit Singh is a contract employee working as a CLTS staff member at DUDA. He was assigned to verify beneficiaries under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana. DUDA Project Director Arvind Pandey confirmed this and said the department would not comment on the personal life of the accused.

According to the complaint, the woman, a resident of the Bhiti area, alleged that she had been in a relationship with Ankit Singh, a resident of Gaurari village in Chandauli district, since 2023. She claimed he established the relationship by promising marriage but later refused, accusing her of having relationships with other men.

The case has taken a political turn after a video of the woman surfaced on social media. In the video, she is seen alleging that some local BJP leaders are pressuring her to compromise. She is also heard saying that Ankit Singh should either marry her or remain in jail, and that she will not agree to any settlement.

Additional Superintendent of Police Anoop Kumar said that the law is the same for everyone and justice will be ensured irrespective of influence or pressure. He confirmed that the accused has been arrested and legal proceedings are continuing.
